title: Schools Command — Grant Compliance & Funding
tagline: Catch the SLA breach or compliance exception before it puts federal funding at risk.
painPoint: Grant compliance exceptions surface during an audit — long after the funding decision that depended on them.

steps.caption: The Schools Command Center
steps.talk: This is the district's command center — financial, academic, HR, and grants, all in one place, not six logins.

steps.caption: AI Analysis, on demand
steps.talk: This is the AI Analysis engine — a district administrator can paste any document and get a compliance read in seconds.

steps.caption: 28 pre-built compliance prompts
steps.talk: The prompt library has 28 pre-built compliance questions, covering everything from 2 CFR 200 cost audits to FERPA — nobody has to know the right question to ask.

steps.caption: AI analysis, one click
steps.talk: One click and the AI runs the full compliance analysis — what would normally take a business office days of cross-referencing federal guidance.

steps.caption: Relayed to strategist
steps.talk: One click relays this straight to the strategist — no re-typing the finding.

steps.caption: Strategist workspace
steps.talk: The strategist view synthesizes the finding into district-wide context.

steps.caption: AI summary, synthesized
steps.talk: This is the summary a superintendent's office would normally wait a week for.

steps.caption: Executive escalation
steps.talk: One click, straight to the executive portal.

steps.caption: Funding exposure, live
steps.talk: Grant and funding exposure across the district, live — the number that actually matters before a federal audit.

cta: TSM catches the compliance exception before the auditor does — not during the audit.
